implementation.note: Mixed-media board, original covers/cardstock, inspector, OFL fonts, approved pale playfield and accessible drag/tap/keyboard lobby are implemented. White UI uses readable Red/Blue accents; server accepts placements and rejects occupied spymaster slots atomically. Local desktop/tablet/phone evidence is recorded in TESTING; exact-head independent review and CI are recorded in PRs.

directionSelection.brief: Physical game cards and original meme covers on the approved pale off-white background with blue-left/red-right edge glow, faint original SVG meme faces and clean red/blue UI. Drag, tap and keyboard lobby.

brand.purpose: Self-hosted Bricolage Grotesque 800 for phrases, clues and small original split-color lettering; face motif omitted at this size.

body.purpose: Self-hosted Atkinson Hyperlegible 400/700 for readable names and controls.

motion.name: accepted-cover
motion.purpose: Downward cover settle only after acceptance; immediate under reduced motion.

focus.onTeam: Deep Blue outer outline plus Gold inset against fill

board.cardAspect: Landscape, 160px height floor; taller narrow cards
board.selection: Local only; explicit Reveal; inspect never selects.

lobby.permissions: Players move themselves; host moves anyone.
lobby.destinations: Red/Blue spymaster slot and operative area; shared unassigned/watch tray.
lobby.occupiedSlot: Reject without demotion or swap; server change required.
lobby.alternatives: Tap piece then named destination; keyboard placement/cancel.
lobby.placement: Preview until server accepts; never publish optimistic roster.
lobby.teamOrder: Blue left / Red right; stacked in that order on phones.

media.gif: Poster first; explicit muted controllable inspector playback.
media.content: Pinned reference/version; IDs and media never encode hidden identity.

coverArt.composition: Large recognizable meme-character portrait, bold ink outlines, layered flat shading and quiet scene hints. Avoid elaborate scenery and ornamental frames.
coverArt.category: Dominant Red, Blue or tan across character and background; Assassin remains predominantly near-black with restrained gray/cream facial lines.
coverArt.assassin: Original Wojak-style reaction portrait; supplied black portrait and hooded wordmark face are character cues, not final drawings.
coverArt.cast: Red, Blue and Neutral cast remains open. Choose directly recognizable meme characters rather than generic meme-like props.
coverArt.production: Separate full-frame landscape covers; semantic edges, shadows, symbols and recognition strips. Supplied sheets remain references requiring adaptation.

wordmark.direction: Heavy condensed italic CODE in Blue, MEMES in Red; optional simplified monochrome Wojak inside O.
wordmark.adaptation: Original lettering and illustration, game palette, flat print treatment; omit face when too small. Keep mark compact on the game screen.
wordmark.status: Reference direction only; no final logo or font selected.

references.note: October 5 user request pins this pale neutral playfield, soft Blue/Red edge glow and sparse meme-face line art. Original SVG adaptation for the app; reference pixels are not shipping media.
Primary cover style reference; adapt portraits, scene and finish. Not shipping cover assets.
Split-color condensed italic wordmark example; original adaptation required. Not final logo artwork.
Secondary physical portrait composition reference only.
Historical exploration; cast, detailed scenes, decorative frames and skeleton Assassin superseded by the supplied portrait brief.

playfield.edgeLight: Soft static Blue left / Red right; neutral center.
playfield.pattern: Original decorative SVG troll/reaction/Doge/Wojak-style faces, plus and pixel marks; 40–70px faces, widely spaced, around 2–4% opacity.
playfield.controlSurface: White with dark ink, clear borders and Red/Blue accents. Cream is reserved for physical cards.
playfield.supersedes: Green felt and pale on-felt UI lettering.

components.name: Meme face
components.description: Implemented phrase, image, or GIF poster with recognition text and separate inspector control.

components.name: Identity cover
components.description: Implemented original meme-character portraits with dominant Red/Blue/tan/near-black category color, Wojak-style Assassin, semantic identity symbol and preserved recognition strip.

components.name: Player piece
components.description: Implemented named piece with dedicated drag handle, initials, presence and host text; tap/keyboard destination picker, explicit Place/Cancel and accepted-state focus/announcements.

components.name: Action tray
components.description: Implemented compact clue or deliberate Reveal/End turn controls.

narrative.overview: Physical cream meme cards and original illustrated covers on a pale off-white playfield, with soft Blue/Red edge light and sparse decorative meme faces. Clean styled UI recedes around the game.

rules.name: Private identity
rules.body: Never deliver an unrevealed identity to a public client, including through media metadata.

rules.name: Accepted-state feedback
rules.body: No committed cover, count or roster placement before server acceptance.

dos: Use the approved pale playfield with faint meme faces and Red/Blue edge light.
Keep controls clean, styled and readable on white/light surfaces.
donts: Do not autoplay a GIF wall.
Do not add marketing or explanatory panels to the game.
Do not reintroduce green felt or pale on-felt labels on the light background.
